script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

JOY (mid 30s, a kind-hearted and energetic woman) stands at the kitchen counter, chopping vegetables for a large pot of chili. Her two children, OLIVIA (8) and MAX (10), enter the kitchen, sleepy-eyed and still in their pajamas.

OLIVIA: (excitedly) Mom, can we make chili together today?

JOY: (smiling) Of course, Olivia! Max, why don't you measure out the spices while your sister chops the veggies?

MAX: (grinning) Got it!

INT. LIVING ROOM - AFTERNOON

The family gathers around the living room, where they find JOSE (early 40s, Joy's husband), browsing the news on his laptop.

JOSE: (frustrated) I've had it up to here with all the negativity in the world! I wish there was more positivity and less conflict.

JOY: (smiling) Well, we can start by being positive influences in our own community. And maybe we can invite the neighborhood kids over for a friendly cook-off!

OLIVIA: (excitedly) Yes! And we can make it a competition!

MAX: (sarcastically) And the losers have to do the dishes.

JOY: (laughs) Absolutely not!

INT. NEIGHBORHOOD PARK - AFTERNOON

Joy, Jose, Olivia, and Max set up tables in the park for the cook-off. Neighborhood families begin to arrive, bringing their best chili recipes.

INT. PARK - COMPETITION

The families gather around the tables, each team presenting their chili. They share stories and laughs as they taste each other's creations.

MAX: (to a neighbor boy) Your chili is really good! I like the way you used the chocolate.

NEIGHBOR BOY: (grinning) Thanks, Max! I got the idea from my dad.

OLIVIA: (to a neighbor girl) Your chili is spicy! I like it!

NEIGHBOR GIRL: (laughs) I'm glad you like it, Olivia! My dad makes it extra spicy because he thinks it's the only way to make good chili.

INT. PARK - AWARDS CEREMONY

After all the chili has been tasted, the families gather around to announce the winners. The winning team receives a trophy made of plastic spoons and a certificate.

JOY: (smiling) And the winners of the chili cook-off are... (drumroll) ...the Smith family!

The Smith family cheers, and the crowd applauds.

INT. KITCHEN - EVENING

Joy, Jose, Olivia, and Max sit down to enjoy their dinner together, reflecting on the day's events.

JOSE: (smiling) Today was a great day. It was so nice to see everyone coming together and enjoying each other's company.

JOY: (nods) And the best part was watching our children make new friends.

OLIVIA: (excitedly) Can we do it again next week?

MAX: (grinning) Sure, but I'm gonna make the winning chili next time!

JOY and JOSE: (laughing) We'll see about that!

FADE OUT.
